decisions.statement: Each name is read from the globals on its own.
The globals are never enumerated as a whole.
Enumerating the globals taints the call stack against protected functions.
These names are worked out from the game's own enumerations.
`akasha temper eso generate chatter-name` writes this code.
An edit by hand to this code is lost at the next run.
This page names the command writing this code rather than the code itself.

definition: the names the game gives its dialogue option codes and its interaction codes
